title: Simultaneous Isolation of DNA, RNA, and miRNA from Kaposi Sarcoma Biopsy
author: Scholte, Browne, et al.

steps.title: Prepare DNase I stock solution
steps.instruction: Using an RNase‑free needle and syringe, inject 550 µL RNase‑free water into the lyophilized DNase I vial (do not open the vial). Gently invert to mix (do not vortex). Aliquot single‑use volumes into labeled vials and store at –30 °C to –15 °C for up to 9 months; thawed aliquots may be kept at 2 °C–8 °C for up to 6 weeks (do not refreeze).

steps.title: Prepare Buffer RPE
steps.instruction: Add 44 mL molecular‑biology‑grade ethanol (96 %–100 %) to the 11 mL Buffer RPE concentrate container, record the date, check the box indicating ethanol added, and store at room temperature (18 °C–25 °C).

steps.title: Prepare Buffer AW1
steps.instruction: Add 25 mL molecular‑biology‑grade ethanol (96 %–100 %) to the 19 mL Buffer AW1 concentrate container, note the date, check the box, and store at ambient temperature (18 °C–25 °C).

steps.title: Prepare Buffer AW2
steps.instruction: Add 30 mL molecular‑biology‑grade ethanol (96 %–100 %) to the 13 mL Buffer AW2 concentrate container, write the date, check the box, and store at room temperature (18 °C–25 °C).

steps.title: Prepare RLT Buffer + β‑ME
steps.instruction: Label a 15 mL conical tube “RLT Buffer + β‑ME”. For 20 preparations (5 samples × 4 vials + 2 extra), add 13 200 µL Buffer RLT; if precipitate forms, warm at 37 °C with gentle agitation for 5 min, then cool to ambient (18 °C–25 °C). Add 132 µL β‑ME (6 µL per vial) to the same tube, homogenize with a 15 mL serological pipette, and store at ambient temperature (18 °C–25 °C) for up to 1 month. Use a fume hood and PPE when handling β‑ME.

steps.title: Initial KS biopsy preparation
steps.instruction: For each KS sample, add 20 µL RLT + β‑ME to three 1.5 mL safe‑lock tubes (A1‑A3) and 400 µL to a fourth tube (A4) containing SST beads. Thaw biopsies on ice and keep at 2 °C–8 °C. Using sterile forceps, wash each biopsy briefly in cold sterile PBS, blot dry on a lab wipe, and weigh on an analytical balance. If weight > 10 mg, place tissue on a microscope slide on ice, cut into two equal portions, and transfer one portion to A1 and the other to A2 (both containing 20 µL RLT + β‑ME). If weight ≤ 10 mg, transfer the whole biopsy to A1 only and discard A2. Keep the tubes on ice until disruption. Use fresh sterile disposables for each sample.

steps.title: Homogenize lysate and bind DNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the QIAshredder tubes containing the lysate at 20 000 × g for 2 min. Transfer the homogenized lysate (avoiding the pellet of steel microparticles) to an AllPrep DNA Mini Spin Column placed in a 2 mL collection tube. Centrifuge 30 s at 20 000 × g. Transfer the DNA Mini Spin Column to a new labeled 2 mL tube, retaining the flow‑through tube (which will be used for RNA purification). Store the DNA column at ambient temperature, 2 °C–8 °C, or on wet ice; do not freeze.

steps.title: Wash DNA column and add Proteinase K
steps.instruction: Add 350 µL Buffer AW1 to the DNA Mini Spin Column, close the lid, centrifuge 30 s at 20 000 × g, discard flow‑through, and dry the tube rim. Prepare a Proteinase K incubation mix: for each vial use 20 µL Proteinase K + 60 µL Buffer AW1; add two extra volumes to compensate for pipetting loss (e.g., for 22 vials total 1 760 µL). Mix gently. Add 80 µL of this mix to the center of the column membrane and incubate on the benchtop for 5 min at ambient temperature.

steps.title: Prepare and warm Buffer EB for elution
steps.instruction: Label two 1.5 mL tubes “Buffer EB”. Calculate 105 µL per vial (add two extra volumes; e.g., 22 × 105 µL = 2 310 µL for 22 vials). Place the tubes in a dry bath at 70 °C to pre‑heat Buffer EB for DNA elution.

steps.title: Final DNA column washes and elution
steps.instruction: Wash the column with 350 µL Buffer AW1 (centrifuge 30 s, discard, dry rim). Add 500 µL Buffer AW2, centrifuge 30 s, discard, dry rim; repeat the Buffer AW2 wash once more. Centrifuge the column 1 min at 20 000 × g to dry residual ethanol. Transfer the column to a new labeled 1.5 mL safe‑lock tube, add 55 µL pre‑heated Buffer EB, incubate 5–10 min at room temperature, then centrifuge 1 min at 20 000 × g. Add a second 50 µL of pre‑heated Buffer EB and centrifuge 1 min again. The combined eluate should be ~100 µL per vial. Combine eluates from the same sample if desired and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Prepare RNase‑free water aliquots
steps.instruction: Label 1.5 mL tubes “RNase‑free H₂O”. Calculate 55 µL per vial (add two extra volumes; e.g., 22 × 55 µL = 1 210 µL). Warm the aliquots in a dry bath at 70 °C for use in RNA elution.

steps.title: Add Proteinase K and ethanol to RNA flow‑through
steps.instruction: To the flow‑through tube from step 4, add 80 µL Proteinase K and mix. Add 350 µL molecular‑biology‑grade ethanol (96 %–100 %), mix, and incubate 10 min at room temperature. Then add an additional 750 µL ethanol, mix.

steps.title: Load sample onto RNeasy column
steps.instruction: Transfer 600 µL of the mixture to an RNeasy Mini Spin Column in a labeled 2 mL tube, close the lid, centrifuge 30 s at 20 000 × g, discard flow‑through, and dry the rim. Repeat this transfer until the entire volume has passed through the column (three passes total).

steps.title: Wash RNA column with Buffer RPE
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL Buffer RPE to the RNeasy column, centrifuge 30 s at 20 000 × g, discard flow‑through, and dry the rim.

steps.title: Prepare DNase I incubation mix
steps.instruction: Label a 2 mL tube “DNase I Incubation Mix”. For each vial use 10 µL reconstituted DNase I + 70 µL Buffer RDD; add two extra volumes (e.g., for 22 vials total 1 760 µL). Mix gently. DNase I is sensitive to denaturation – do not vortex.

steps.title: DNase I treatment of RNA column
steps.instruction: Add 80 µL of the DNase I incubation mix to the center of the RNeasy column membrane and incubate 15 min at ambient temperature (18 °C–25 °C).

steps.title: FRN buffer wash and flow‑through handling
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL ready‑to‑use Buffer FRN to the column, centrifuge 30 s at 20 000 × g, and retain the flow‑through for the next step. Transfer the column to a new 2 mL tube, apply the saved flow‑through, centrifuge 30 s at 20 000 × g, discard flow‑through, and dry the rim.

steps.title: Final RNA column washes with ethanol
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL Buffer RPE, centrifuge 30 s at 20 000 × g, discard, and dry; repeat once more. Then add 500 µL molecular‑biology‑grade ethanol, centrifuge 30 s at 20 000 × g, discard, and dry; repeat the ethanol wash once more. Finally, centrifuge the closed column 1 min at 20 000 × g to remove residual ethanol.

steps.title: Elute total RNA and store
steps.instruction: Transfer the column to a new labeled 1.5 mL safe‑lock tube. Add 55 µL warm RNase‑free water (70 °C) to the membrane, incubate 5–10 min at ambient temperature, then centrifuge 1 min at 20 000 × g to elute. Repeat the elution with the same eluate and tube (second 55 µL elution) and centrifuge 1 min again. The final eluate volume should be ~50 µL per vial. Combine eluates from the same sample if desired, keep on ice while aliquoting, and store at –80 °C.
